details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:1691-1698 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The success path takes run_id from `capture_run_id "Implement"`, which returns the newest-created Implement run (the duplicate). It does not use IMPL_RUN_ID_WORKING, so deep verify and the soft-error analyser can inspect the wrong run.
  WHY: Severity disagreement: sonnet-5_5 rated it NIT (confidence 2), minimax and glm rated it MAJOR, so the highest is used. Consumers are at lines 1853, 2819 and 3001. The replay test covers only the timeout path.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:1352-1360 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: Phase 3a unconditionally posts an `/approved` comment before searching for an existing one.
  WHY: The unconditional POST triggers a duplicate Implement run queued behind the original working run, which is the scenario behind the stall in #8391.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:1384 | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The jq filter requires `created_at` to be exactly 20 characters matching ^...Z$.
  WHY: A timestamp with fractional seconds would make the filter return empty and fall back to the duplicate run, which re-introduces the race. (z-ai_glm-5_3-flash dropped the same concern as speculative.)
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:1367,1377-1387 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The jq trust filter claims to match Implement's job predicate but is broader. It ignores AI_PIPELINE_APPROVER_LOGIN, which implement.yml lines 105-129 check.
  WHY: A comment that implement.yml would reject can move `approved_at` earlier and widen the window. This is not a gate bypass. All three rated it NIT.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: Before posting, read the issue's comments, retrying for up to about 90 seconds, because Phase 2 can exit before the plan's auto-approval lands, and look for an existing trusted /approved comment.
  expected_change_site: .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml Phase 3a approve step (comment-read loop, lines 1352-1376)
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: The comments are read only after the POST at lines 1356-1359, the loop at lines 1370-1376 retries only on API failure with about 4-6 seconds of sleep versus about 90 in the issue, and no test covers a plan comment that lands after the read. Severity disagreement: sonnet-5_5 rated it NIT (confidence 3, judging the chosen design to fix the root cause), the others MAJOR.
- requirement: If a trusted /approved exists, post nothing and set approved_at to that comment's created_at. The regression test should assert no second /approved is posted.
  expected_change_site: .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml Phase 3a approve step POST (lines 1356-1359); tests/test_test_and_mark_stable_plan_polling_guard.py
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: The POST is unconditional and precedes the comment read, and `test_approve_window_starts_at_earlier_plan_auto_approval` asserts `len(_approve_posts(calls)) == 1`. The changelog documents the always-POST as deliberate. Severity disagreement: sonnet-5_5 rated it NIT, the others MAJOR.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:1691-1698 | severity=NIT | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: The reported run_id is the newest-created Implement run, which in the #8391 scenario is Phase 3a's own duplicate, not the working run in IMPL_RUN_ID_WORKING (lines 1600-1626, 1732).
  WHY: Deep verify and the soft-error analyser may inspect a pending or empty duplicate. The same selection applied before this PR, and the issue does not ask to change it.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:1367,1381-1382 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The trust filter says it matches Implement's job predicate but is broader. implement.yml lines 105-129 use AI_PIPELINE_APPROVER_LOGIN, and the jq filter does not.
  WHY: A comment that did not start an Implement run can move `approved_at` earlier. The documented trust contract is inaccurate, but the gate cannot pass falsely.
TASK_GAP:
- requirement: Fix item 1 says to read comments before posting, retry for about 90 seconds, and post nothing if a trusted `/approved` exists. The regression test should assert no second `/approved` is posted.
  expected_change_site: Phase 3a `approve` step, .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml lines 1352-1399, and tests/test_test_and_mark_stable_plan_polling_guard.py
  evidence: The POST at lines 1356-1359 is unconditional and precedes the read. The loop at lines 1370-1376 retries only on API failure. The test asserts exactly one POST. The reviewer judged this a deliberate design that fixes the root cause.
  severity=NIT, confidence=3
- Reviewer's other sections (security, concurrency, error paths, performance, DB, naming): NONE.
- HARDENING_SUGGESTIONS: reword the comment at lines 1367 and 1381-1382 to "superset of Implement's job predicate", or add the approver-login condition to the jq filter (2-4 lines). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:1384 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The jq filter requires `created_at` to be exactly 20 characters matching ^...Z$.
  WHY: It is brittle and would fail on fractional-second timestamps, falling back to a duplicate run and re-introducing the race.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:1352-1360 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Phase 3a unconditionally posts an `/approved` comment before searching for an existing one.
  WHY: It immediately triggers a duplicate Implement run queued behind the original working run, the scenario behind #8391.
TASK_GAP:
- Requirement: "Before posting, read the issue's comments, retrying for up to about 90 seconds, because Phase 2 can exit before the plan's auto-approval lands; look for an existing trusted /approved comment."
  Expected change site: .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml, Phase 3a approve step (comment-read loop, lines 1370-1376)
  Evidence of absence: The comments are read only after the POST (lines 1352-1360), and the 3-attempt loop retries only on API failure with about 6 seconds of sleep versus about 90. The test does not cover a plan comment that has not yet landed.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR, ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
- Requirement: "If one exists, post nothing and set approved_at to that comment's created_at"
  Expected change site: .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml Phase 3a approve step (unconditional POST, lines 1352-1360)
  Evidence of absence: The POST is unconditional and precedes the comment read, and the code always posts a new comment.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR, ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
- Requirement: "Add a regression test... assert no second /approved is posted and approved_at equals that comment's timestamp."
  Expected change site: tests/test_test_and_mark_stable_plan_polling_guard.py
  Evidence of absence: `test_approve_window_starts_at_earlier_plan_auto_approval` asserts `len(_approve_posts(calls)) == 1`, but the implementation always makes one POST. It does not verify the post would be skipped if an approval existed.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR, ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 3
- Reviewer's other sections: NONE.
=== END FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:1377-1387, 1391-1396 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The trust predicate accepts any Bot with `[auto-approved-by-plan]` and any OWNER/MEMBER/COLLABORATOR User, but does not check AI_PIPELINE_APPROVER_LOGIN as implement.yml lines 105-129 do.
  WHY: An off-identity comment can widen the window start or move `approved_at`, so Phase 3b watches runs the configured approver never authorised. It is not a bypass on its own, and the predicate misrepresents implement.yml (line 1367).
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:1691-1698, 1517-1539, 1853, 2819, 3001 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `capture_run_id "Implement"` returns the newest-created non-skipped Implement run (`sort_by(.created_at) | last` in scripts/comprehensive_test_and_release_gh_api.sh:240-250). With the duplicate created later, IMPL_RUN_ID points at the duplicate and the soft-error analyser (line 1853) and deep-verify (line 3001) inspect the wrong run.
  WHY: A skipped duplicate is filtered out, but a non-skipped one is not. The replay test exercises only the timeout exit and never asserts the success-path `outputs.run_id`.
TASK_GAP:
- Requirement: "Before posting, read the issue's comments, retrying for up to about 90 seconds, because Phase 2 can exit before the plan's auto-approval lands" (issue #8391, Suggested fix §1)
  Expected change site: .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml, Phase 3a `approve` step body (comment-read loop at lines 1369-1376)
  Evidence of absence: The read comes after the POST (lines 1356-1359) and retries only on HTTP failure with about 4 seconds of sleep. If the plan's comment lands later than that, the window falls back to `APPROVE_POSTED_AT` and `approval_source=e2e`. No test covers a plan comment landing after the read.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR, ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
- Requirement: "If one exists, post nothing and set approved_at to that comment's created_at, so Phase 3b's window includes the run it started" (issue #8391, Suggested fix §1)
  Expected change site: .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml POST at lines 1356-1359; tests/test_test_and_mark_stable_plan_polling_guard.py
  Evidence of absence: The POST is unconditional. `test_approve_window_starts_at_earlier_plan_auto_approval` asserts `len(_approve_posts(calls)) == 1`. The changelog documents it as a deviation, but it produces the duplicate run behind the run-id capture defect.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR, ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
- Reviewer's other sections: NONE.
- HARDENING_SUGGESTIONS: .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:1391-1393. The `created=>` filter is strict greater-than at one-second precision, so a working run created in the same second as the plan's comment falls outside the window. Fix: back-date the adopted APPROVE_EARLIEST by one second (about 3 lines). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5_3-flash ===
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:1691-1698 (also 1517-1539, 1853, 2819) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The success path binds `run_id` to the newest-created scoped Implement run, which is deterministically the duplicate (for example 40936365554 vs working 40936238289). IMPL_RUN_ID_WORKING (lines 1600/1626) is never used for the `run_id` output.
  WHY: Deep verify and the soft-error analyser inspect a no-op duplicate, so a real failure in the working run can be reported as verified. This is the issue #4723 class. The replay test covers only the timeout path.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:1380-1382 (comment at 1367; implement.yml:104-128) | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The jq trust filter is broader than the Implement job condition it claims to mirror. Bot comments are accepted regardless of AI_PIPELINE_APPROVER_LOGIN, and OWNER/MEMBER/COLLABORATOR User comments are accepted regardless of the approver variable and the marker.
  WHY: With the approver variable set, the window can start earlier than any run Implement would start, which degrades tracking for the grace period.
